description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for browsing recipes in the Coocook application. It includes methods for listing recipes, viewing a specific recipe, importing recipes, and related actions, with dependencies on models, utilities, and external modules.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Browse::Recipe
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class managing recipe browsing, viewing, and importing actions within the Coocook application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles listing recipes, including filtering based on user permissions and project associations, and prepares data for rendering.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a specific recipe by ID and URL name, setting it in the stash for subsequent actions.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Prepares data for importing recipes from other projects, including generating URLs for import actions.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a specific recipe, including ingredients and related project information, with optional servings adjustment.
